authority: owner ruling of 2026-08-19, Run 36 blocker closure, section 10
what_this_is: The owner-authorized controlled-study design counts and participant sequence, stated ONCE and machine-readable so a guard can compare the ACTUAL enumerated stimuli against them. The stimuli are NOT generated from this file: this file is written down and the corpus is enumerated independently, and the guard fails when the two disagree in either direction.

controlled_stimulus.why_this_root: It is the root the LIVE loader server/tests/synthetic_fixtures/importers/fixture_loader.py reads, and it is the only governed, versioned, checksummed project-period corpus in the repository.

participant_sequence: AI reveal, permitted only after the preliminary lock
final action, confidence, disposition, evidence and rationale

participant_sequence_enforcement.preliminary_lock: server/app/research_decision.py refuses resubmission of a locked preliminary judgment
participant_sequence_enforcement.reveal_after_lock: server/app/research_models.py CheckConstraint ck_decisions_reveal_after_pre_lock, enforced in the database itself
participant_sequence_enforcement.final_lock: server/app/research_decision.py refuses a second final decision for an assignment

declared_limitations: This contract binds the controlled STIMULUS CORPUS and the participant SEQUENCE. It does not assert that any participant database currently holds 36 assignments: Scenario.period_count is a nullable per-scenario integer and ConditionSequence rows are operator-configured. Run 36 reported that and the report is not withdrawn.

research_fixtures/README.md bars these synthetic records from entering an operational or participant database. The corpus is the controlled evidence the instrument computes over; it is not bulk-imported into a participant store, and nothing here authorizes that.
Nothing in this contract is empirical validation. The corpus carries not_for_empirical_validation = true on every row.
